name: Solo · Stay a Little Longer
teacher: Ms. Brittany (weekly solo rehearsal; Hannah not available on a regular schedule)
rehearsal: Wednesdays 3:30–4:00 solo rehearsal with Ms. Brittany · Thu/Fri/Sun home practice
costume: Option 6 · Kellé Blossom Within — Leotard #5448A (lycra with ruched stretch-mesh wrap overlay, open crisscross back, organza flower appliqués you place yourself) + Draped Skirt #4518A (asymmetrical mesh, ruched front drape, longer back hem, attached lined trunks). Color: BLUSH for both. Leotard sized by girth; skirt by waist/hips.
music: Track is 2:04. Soft verse 0:00–0:48. Big swell at 0:48, full volume to 1:52. Fade 1:52–2:00, silent by 2:00. In the loud section a strong beat lands about every 2.3 seconds: finish every shape ON it.
map: ~0:12 floor work & tailbone balance · ~0:18 lunge reach · ~0:34 attitude with arms up · ~0:50 cartwheel (right on the swell) · ~1:08 walkover/handstand · ~1:42 floor kick · ~1:50 passé turns · 1:53–2:03 floor ending — hold until the music is gone
strengths: Floor work is smooth, no crashing in or out
Full-body reach on the lunge (arms past the body)
Committed acro: cartwheel, walkover, handstand line is clean
Straight standing leg in attitude and passé
corrections: Point the foot and straighten the knee on the tailbone balance and every floor extension
Side extension: commit to a clean attitude or straighten it — no halfway
Eyes up: plan a focal point for every section, stop checking the mirror/Hannah
Passé: toe to the side of the knee, high relevé, sharp spot
Cartwheel prep should look like choreography, not a setup
#feet Donut roll: chin tucked, roll over the shoulder, chest leads
Hold the final floor shape until 2:00 when the sound is fully gone
tricks: Tailbone balance: seated leg extension with pointed foot, hold 5s ×5 each leg; boat pose 3×15s. Cue: lock the knee before the foot leaves the floor.
Side extension: développé side in 4 counts up, hold 2, 4 down, at a counter — 6 each side. Side-lying leg lifts 2×12. Decide with Ms. Brittany: clean attitude or straight leg.

Cartwheel on the swell: drill the 4 counts before it as dancing — reach, look, place. Head stays up until the hands go down. Legs pass through vertical along a floor line. Land with the arm finish on the beat.
Walkover/handstand line: belly-to-wall handstand 3×10–15s, kick-ups to vertical with straight legs, split shape at the top. Wrists warmed up first. Kick-overs only with a spotter until cleared.
Floor kick: kick from the hip not the back; 8 slow kicks each side with a pointed foot at the top; hamstring stretch after.
Passé turns: passé balance on relevé 10s; quarter turns, then half, then single; spot a sticker on the wall; arms round like holding a beach ball.
The ending: play the last 15 seconds of the real track 5 times and hold the shape, breathing, until it is silent. Count 8 more after you think it is over.

Donut roll (~0:19–0:25): warm the back first (cobra, then seal). Kneeling backbend with hands to heels 3×5s. Bridge holds 3×10s. Then the donut shape: knees bent, chest open, eyes to the ceiling then the wall behind. Roll over the SHOULDER with the chin tucked, never over the head. Cue: lead with the chest, follow with the eyes.

name: Trio · Enjoy the Silence
rehearsal: Choreography day Sun Sep 27, 10:00–12:00 · mark it once a week at home (Thursday)
map: Kneeling line → floor phrase with all three legs up (~0:12) → rolls (~0:19–0:24) → kneeling reach → low crawl into lying arch (~0:36–0:44) → rise (~0:45) → wide traveling triangle (~0:48–1:05) → run with acro (~1:06–1:16). More to come.
strengths: Straight vertical leg with a pointed foot in the floor phrase
Deep lunge + arm reach (~0:57) is her best line
Dances the traveling section full size
corrections: Match the leg height the three agree on — three heights reads as three pictures
Count the rolls out loud (she was a beat behind at ~0:21)
Arms in second: at or above shoulder, long elbows
Forward folds hinge at the hips, not through the back
Eyelines agree with the other two in the standing section

name: PITCH · Jazz group · Groove Is in the Heart
song: Groove Is in the Heart — Deee-Lite (2:31 cut)
music: 2:31 cut at about 123 BPM, so one 8-count is about 3.9 seconds (roughly 38 eights total). Quiet intro 0:00–0:08 · builds 0:08–0:24 · full groove 0:24–1:12 · breakdown/dip 1:12–1:20 · full groove 1:20–1:48 · BIG DROP-OUT 1:52–1:56 (almost silent — a hit or freeze lives here) · final push 1:56–2:26 · tail to 2:31.
map: 0:08 first energy jump · 0:24 groove locks in · 1:12 breakdown · 1:52 the silence (hold it!) · 1:56 last section starts · 2:26 ending
corrections: Jazz is about sharp accents: hit and stop on the beat, no melting between shapes
Match the biggest dancer's size on every travel step
Freeze completely in the 1:52 silence — any wobble shows
